answer: Picture trust as an orchard: each agent is a tree and endorsements are grafts between them. Every epoch a public random beacon picks seed agents, and short random walks run from each seed along endorsement edges, crediting the agents they reach. Honest agents form a dense grove, so walks spread through it. A sybil farm, however many keys it mints, links to that grove through only a few attack edges, a canyon with one thin bridge, so walks rarely cross and the fakes earn little. The attacker must buy real endorsements, not keys.
